payload.text: CAPABILITY (plugin Tier-0 native dispatch): celnet-plugin-host::native::NativeModel<M>::price is the Tier-0 native plugin pricing dispatch — a pure, side-effect-free delegation that forwards (OptionType, &CarryInputs) to the inner PricingModel and returns HostResult<f64> with no host-side I/O, allocation-mutation, or logging. It proves a user-supplied native model and the fuel-metered Tier-2 wasm-sandboxed model both register and dispatch through the ONE PricingModel::price(opt, CarryInputs) seam of the same ModelRegistry, so native and wasm twins agree bit-for-bit through one registry (native_and_wasm_twins_agree_through_one_registry); the Tier-2 sandbox path itself is fuel-metered and is therefore deliberately NOT claimed pure here.
